scripts.cert: mkdir -p .certs && if command -v mkcert >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkcert -key-file .certs/dev-key.pem -cert-file .certs/dev-cert.pem localhost 127.0.0.1 ::1; else echo 'mkcert not found -- falling back to self-signed. Chrome will warn AND refuse the service worker Experience Builder needs, so dashboards will fail. Install mkcert, run "mkcert -install", then rerun this.'; openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 825 -keyout .certs/dev-key.pem -out .certs/dev-cert.pem -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1'; fi
